question: On four unseen frames, does CENTER32 increase scene-linear edge-reference RMSE to at least 1.5 times NATURAL32 on every frame, against a reliable dual independent NATURAL1024 reference proxy?

evidenceBasis.derivationObservation: CENTER32/NATURAL32 edge-reference RMSE ratios were 2.2360, 2.1876 and 2.2623 on three derivation frames; dual NATURAL1024 reference disagreement was zero on two frames and far below candidate error on the third.

design.type: six fresh Blender processes rendering four unseen holdout frames
design.frameSelectionRule: Selected before formal output; disjoint from B31 derivation frames and B30 frame 38.

referenceProxy.definition: Pixelwise mean of two independent NATURAL1024 scene-linear RGB outputs per holdout frame.
referenceProxy.reliabilityMetric: REFERENCE1024 A/B edge RMSE divided by mean NATURAL32 edge RMSE.
referenceProxy.whyFivePercent: A conservative ceiling far above derivation reference disagreement while requiring proxy noise to remain small relative to the comparison denominator.

edgeRule.gradient: RGB Euclidean central difference of the dual-reference mean
edgeRule.maskDefinition: Pixels with gradient magnitude greater than or equal to the per-frame 95th percentile.

primaryEndpoint.name: allFrameEdgeReferenceCostRatio
primaryEndpoint.naturalError: Mean edge RMSE of NATURAL32_A and NATURAL32_B against the dual-reference mean.
primaryEndpoint.centerError: Mean edge RMSE of CENTER32_A and CENTER32_B against the dual-reference mean.
primaryEndpoint.supportRule: All four holdout-frame ratios must be at least 1.5 after the reference reliability gate passes.
primaryEndpoint.directionReversalRule: Any holdout-frame ratio below 1.0 takes EDGE_COST_DIRECTION_REVERSED with precedence over support.
primaryEndpoint.whyOnePointFive: The threshold is contracted toward no effect from the minimum derivation ratio 2.1876 and frozen before holdout output.

secondaryEndpoints: global and non-edge CENTER32/NATURAL32 RMSE ratios by frame
REFERENCE1024 A/B global and edge disagreement
NATURAL32 and CENTER32 A/B repeatability by frame
MAE and maximum absolute error by cell, replicate, ROI and frame
container SHA, byte count and render time for every EXR

decisionRule.REFERENCE_PROXY_UNSTABLE: Any frame has reference A/B edge RMSE greater than 5% of mean NATURAL32 edge RMSE, or a non-positive natural denominator.
decisionRule.EDGE_COST_DIRECTION_REVERSED: The proxy is reliable, but at least one holdout frame has CENTER/NATURAL edge RMSE ratio below 1.0.
decisionRule.EDGE_REFERENCE_COST_SUPPORT: The proxy is reliable and all four holdout-frame edge RMSE ratios are at least 1.5.
decisionRule.MIXED_EDGE_REFERENCE_COST: The proxy is reliable, no frame reverses direction, and one to three holdout frames reach 1.5.
decisionRule.EDGE_REFERENCE_COST_NOT_REPRODUCED: The proxy is reliable, no frame reverses direction, and no holdout frame reaches 1.5.
decisionRule.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Any identity, source, process, cell, frame, output, EXR layout, finite-value, binding, frozen-contract, attack or human-status gate fails.

requiredNegativeCases: B30 result or spec identity mismatch
derivation result or analysis identity mismatch
PID uniqueness or cell binding mismatch
frame set, render count or frame order mismatch
analysis, manifest or file-hash binding mismatch
reference, edge, threshold, sample-size, precedence or decision-rule mutation
explicitNonClaims: A dual NATURAL1024 mean is a stable reference proxy in derivation, not ground truth or a spatially supersampled reference.
Larger scene-linear edge-reference RMSE does not by itself prove visible aliasing, worse perceived sharpness or lower cinematic quality.
The top-5-percent gradient ROI is a frozen numerical edge proxy, not a semantic object boundary or calibrated contrast-sensitivity model.
Four holdout frames test this animated scene at fixed times; they do not establish a universal Blender, Eevee, GPU or content bound.
CENTER stability and edge-reference cost may coexist; neither endpoint cancels the other.
Human review and temporal playback remain PENDING separate gates.
